speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A certain man had two sons, and the younger said, Father, give me the portion. He gathered all, and took his journey into a far country.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He will not be brief. An hour and a half, and the boy is still on the road. I call that timely.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him get as far as the husks.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine, and he began to be in want.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. Want. Mark me, he comes home before I have sat the whole of this, or I have misjudged the text, and I have not misjudged a text this year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He comes home. That is the part a parish sits for.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I will not name a road, nor a purse. The far country is far enough without a man's own errand put into it.
